description: PARTIAL SAVE: writes ONLY the 'Push' field of TitlePublicConfigurationModel; all other v1/v2 fields stay untouched. Push notifications - the title's settings for messages delivered to a player who is NOT in the game right now (Web Push in the browser, FCM/APNs on mobile). IsEnabled is the master switch and defaults to DISABLED: notifications spend a real person's attention and require their browser permission, so a title opts in explicitly. MaxSendsPerUserPerDay caps how many a single player receives; MaxSendsPerTitlePerDay caps the title as a whole and is the ONLY ceiling on a broadcast that exists anywhere - the publisher API quota does not see sends at all, because they run in a queue worker rather than in a request pipeline. QuietHoursStart/End suppress sends during the night in the SUBSCRIPTION's locale (the window may cross midnight); waking a person at 3am is the fastest way to lose the browser permission permanently. Mobile holds only the NAMES of TitleSecrets entries for the publisher's Firebase service account and APNs .p8 key, never the credentials. VAPID keys are NOT here and never will be - they are platform-wide environment variables shared by both backends. Subscriptions themselves are not config either: they live in the shared PushEndpoints/PushBindings collections, one row per browser or device plus one row per topic it follows.

Icon.description: Event icon; empty falls back to the section's DefaultIcon.

IsEnabled.description: Whether this event sends a notification. Not set = disabled.

TitleKey.description: Localization key of the title. Empty means the event is not sent at all: a notification without a title is a blank grey box.

Url.description: Where tapping the notification leads. Empty = the game itself.

ApnsBundleId.description: App bundle id, used as the APNs topic.

ApnsKeyId.description: APNs key id (the 'kid' header of the provider token). Public by nature.

ApnsKeySecretName.description: Name of the TitleSecrets entry holding the APNs .p8 private key. Never the key itself.

ApnsTeamId.description: Apple team id (the 'iss' claim of the provider token). Public by nature.

ApnsUseSandbox.description: Send to Apple's sandbox host instead of production. This is an ADDRESS, not a debug flag: a token issued to a development build is rejected by the production host with BadDeviceToken and vice versa. Not set = production.

FcmServiceAccountSecretName.description: Name of the TitleSecrets entry holding the Firebase service-account JSON. Never the JSON itself.

value.description: Push notification settings for the title: the master switch, per-player and per-title send ceilings, quiet hours, and the NAMES of the publisher's mobile credentials in TitleSecrets. VAPID keys are NOT here - they are platform-wide environment variables. Subscriptions themselves live in the shared PushEndpoints/PushBindings collections, not in the config.

DefaultIcon.description: Default notification icon (absolute URL). Empty = the browser's own default.

Events.description: Which GAME EVENTS send a notification, keyed by event id ("chat.direct", "social.friend_request"). An event that is absent is never sent, and costs zero database work. Only things ANOTHER person did are here - there is no scheduler on the platform, so "your energy is full" style reminders do not exist.

IsEnabled.description: Master switch. Not set = DISABLED (unlike Chat/Tutorial): notifications spend a real person's attention, so a title must opt in explicitly.

MaxSendsPerTitlePerDay.description: Title-wide daily cap. 0 = unlimited. This is the ONLY ceiling on broadcasts: the publisher API quota does not see sends at all, because they run in a queue worker rather than in a request pipeline.

MaxSendsPerUserPerDay.description: Per-player daily cap. 0 = unlimited. Not set = platform default (10).

Mobile.description: Mobile transports (FCM/APNs). Contains only the NAMES of TitleSecrets entries, never the credentials themselves.

QuietHoursEnd.description: Quiet hours end (0..23). Only meaningful together with the start.

QuietHoursStart.description: Quiet hours start (0..23), in the SUBSCRIPTION's locale. Not set = never quiet.
